about: Strapi 5 single types over GraphQL, checked against strapi-php's GraphQL plugin. Run on an empty database whose locales are en (the default) and fr, in order, with strapi-populate-vectors.mjs. Homepage is a single type with draft and publish, a relation and a component; Global is a localized single type whose contact is shared by every locale.

writes.name: a single type with no entry answers null
deleting a single type with no entry is not found
the first update makes the entry as a draft
writes.graphql: mutation { updateHomepage(status: DRAFT, data: { title: "Welcome", body: "Hello", featured: "@books:Dune", price: { minor: 500, currency: "EUR" } }) { title body publishedAt featured { title } price { minor currency } } }

writes.name: a draft is not published
the draft is read by its status
writes.graphql: { homepage(status: DRAFT) { title publishedAt featured { title } } }

writes.name: an update with the default status publishes
writes.graphql: mutation { updateHomepage(data: { title: "Welcome back" }) { title body publishedAt } }

writes.name: the published entry is read
writes.graphql: { homepage { title body publishedAt price { minor currency } } }

writes.name: the published entry is filtered by publication
an update with variables
writes.graphql: mutation Edit($data: HomepageInput!) { updateHomepage(status: DRAFT, data: $data) { title body } }

writes.name: a single type has no documentId argument
a single type has no list
a single type has no create
deleting the entry answers its documentId
the deleted entry is gone
a localized single type is made in the default locale
writes.graphql: mutation { updateGlobal(data: { siteName: "Books", contact: "hi@example.test" }) { siteName contact locale } }

writes.name: and in another locale
writes.graphql: mutation { updateGlobal(locale: "fr", data: { siteName: "Livres" }) { siteName contact locale } }

writes.name: the default locale is read
writes.graphql: { global { siteName contact locale localizations { siteName locale } } }

writes.name: another locale is read
a locale with no entry answers null
deleting one locale
leaves the others
the deleted locale is gone
